Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor (GIST): F9: Transbronchial needle aspiration of a right hilar mass showed benign bronchial cells
F6: Laboratory studies, including a complete blood count and comprehensive metabolic profile, were within normal limits
F14: Upper endoscopy and colonoscopy identified no other lesions
F7: Noncontrast chest CT revealed a retrocardiac necrotic mediastinal mass measuring 1.2 × 8.6 × 10.7 cm
F10: EUS-guided FNA of an oval, hypoechoic posterior mediastinal lesion (68 × 70 mm) obtained a core biopsy that demonstrated a spindle cell neoplasm with large nuclei and prominent nucleoli
F11: Immunohistochemical staining was positive for CD117, DOG1, Cam5.2, and AE1/AE3
F12: Somatic genetic analysis of cKIT and PDGFRA revealed no mutations
F13: Germline testing was positive for NF1, suggesting wild-type GIST
F15: PET imaging showed FDG uptake in multiple pulmonary nodules, hilar lymph nodes, and a pleural-based lesion on the seventh rib
F16: The patient was started on imatinib
